# THE ZETA HARP · CLAIM BOUNDARY

*What this instrument refuses, stated before it exists, enforced by pins
after. The standing label, carried on the surface itself: KNOWN
MATHEMATICS. INTERACTIVE SCIENTIFIC AND ARTISTIC INSTRUMENT. NOT EVIDENCE
FOR RH.*

The Harp does not, in any register, science or installation:

1. prove, support, or evidence the Riemann Hypothesis. It is built on
   s = 1/2 + it and cannot see off the line. The cancellation rooms carry:
   "This chamber explains cancellation at known critical-line zeros. It
   does not determine whether off-line zeros exist."
2. revive the cube. The 27-bin digit map returned its recorded null. No
   cube, Trinity, 54-observer, 108, 11664, or 27-cell structure appears as
   evidence; any such decor in any mode carries: "Symbolic installation
   object. The tested digit-cube mapping returned NULL."
3. call 2pi n squared a frequency. It is the entry height of term n. The
   frequency is (theta'(t) - log n)/2pi.
4. present |sum of phasors| as |Z|, the main sum as exact Z, or hide the
   remainder.
5. mint a certified zero from an approximate crossing, or call a zero list
   complete without the Riemann-von Mangoldt count check wired and passing.
   "Rigorous" and "certified" appear only where interval arithmetic
   actually ran.
6. stage a zero as silence unless Z_ref audio is actually playing through
   zero.
7. call the viewing frame a dimension, or connect the 26-term window to
   bosonic string theory's critical dimension as anything but a labelled
   analogy behind an explicit toggle. The window is one of an infinite
   family, one for every N; the mathematics does not distinguish 26.
8. say zeros cause primes or that a term causes a zero. Ablation is
   exploratory numerics.
9. validate the Golden Horizon Principle or phi, or find privileged
   pitches. Both canons refuse this bridge already, from both sides.
10. claim priority. No "first", no "historic", before PRIOR_ART.md exists.
    Arias-de-Reyna (arXiv:math/0309433, 2003) already caps "first
    visualization". Until the review: "We have not established priority."

The claim linter enforces the banned phrases over BOTH registers,
installation copy included, and it is a pin: a fence that is not a test is
a wish.
